sources.snippet: Abstract Multimodal zero-shot and few-shot learning integrate multiple data modalities-such as text, images, audio, and video-to enhance AI generalization with minimal training examples.

sources.title: Few-Shot Learning Based on Multimodal Information Processing
sources.snippet: Few-shot learning aims to develop models with strong generalization capabilities using a small number of training samples. However, most learning methods rely solely on the visual features of a few samples to represent entire categories, leading to poor category representativeness. sources.title: Few-shot Adaptation of Multi-modal Foundation Models: A Survey
sources.snippet: Therefore, in this survey, we introduce and analyze the research advancements in few-shot adaptation methods for multi-modal models, summarizing commonly used datasets and experimental setups, and comparing the results of different methods.
